in_marathi.name: Monotosh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Monotosh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Monotosh is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'Moon God'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a celestial body that represents knowledge, power, and fertility. The name Monotosh is believed to bring blessings of knowledge, wisdom, and prosperity.
